questions.question: What is the primary purpose of metalwork?
questions.explanation: Metalwork involves creating objects, shaping materials, and joining components.

questions.explanation: Steel is the most common metal used in metalwork due to its strength and versatility.

questions.question: What is the process of heating metal to make it easier to work called?
